settings._note: The geopolitical filter (filter/classes.json, filter/geofilter.py). An event or headline counts only if it passes: its weight G reaches theta, its class is among these classes, war and disputes reach min_hostility on the MID scale, and, with pair_gate set, it is politically relevant (a COW major power, or two contiguous states). marks 'seed' reads with the classes' words only; 'learned' also uses the counts built from the author's marks (model, kept off the repos). A change here rebuilds the member's cache.

classes.name: War
classes.source: COW War Data v4.0 (inter-, extra- and non-state wars) and v5.1 (intra-state wars)
classes.codes: War type 1 inter-state; 2 colonial, 3 imperial (extra-state); 4 civil war for central control, 5 civil war over local issues, 6 regional internal, 7 intercommunal (intra-state); 8 non-state war in non-state territory, 9 non-state war across state borders. A war is sustained combat with at least 1,000 battle-related deaths in twelve months. MID hostility level 5.

classes.name: Militarized dispute
classes.source: COW Militarized Interstate Disputes 5.0 (1816-2014): MID 5.0 codebook and incident coding manual
classes.codes: Hostility level 1 no militarized action, 2 threat to use force, 3 display of force, 4 use of force, 5 war. Highest action: threats 1 use force, 2 blockade, 3 occupy territory, 4 declare war, 5 use CBR weapons, 6 join war [level 2]; displays 7 show of force, 8 alert, 9 nuclear alert, 10 mobilization, 11 fortify border, 12 border violation [3]; uses 13 blockade, 14 occupation of territory, 15 seizure, 16 attack, 17 clash, 18 declaration of war, 19 use of CBR weapons [4]; 20 begin, 21 join interstate war [5]. Fatality level 0-6. COW codes these for state forces; here they are read for any armed actor.

classes.name: Alignment
classes.source: COW Formal Alliances v4.1 (1816-2012); Defense Cooperation Agreement Dataset (1980-2010); Intergovernmental Organizations v3 (1815-2014)
classes.codes: Alliance type I defense pact, IIa neutrality, IIb non-aggression, III entente. Defense cooperation agreements: framework treaties for routine defence cooperation. IGO status 0 none, 1 full member, 2 associate member, 3 observer.

classes.name: Diplomatic representation
classes.source: COW Diplomatic Exchange 2006.1 (1817-2005); State System Membership v2024 (diplomatic missions)
classes.codes: Representation 0 none, 1 charge d'affaires, 2 minister, 3 ambassador, 9 other. An ambassador expelled, recalled or withdrawn is coded 1.

classes.name: Territorial change
classes.source: COW Territorial Change v6 (1816-2018); MID issue type 1; Direct Contiguity v3.2
classes.codes: Procedure 1 conquest, 2 annexation, 3 cession, 4 secession, 5 unification, 6 mandated territory. MID issue type 1 territory.

classes.name: Capability
classes.source: COW National Material Capabilities v7.0 (1816-2022); Arms Technology v1.1 (1816-2023)
classes.codes: Military expenditure, military personnel, energy consumption, iron and steel production, urban population, total population, combined as CINC. Arms technologies: small arms, machine guns, artillery, tanks, fighter aircraft, combat helicopters, armed UAVs; ballistic missiles and ICBMs (v1.1).

classes.name: Agreement and negotiation
classes.source: Not from COW. CAMEO event codes (the coding GDELT uses): 02, 03, 04, 057, 087, 10, 12, 13, 16
classes.codes: CAMEO 04 consult (041 discuss by telephone, 042 make a visit, 043 host a visit, 044 meet at a third location, 045 mediate, 046 engage in negotiation); 026-028, 036-039 meet, negotiate, settle, mediate; 057 sign formal agreement; 087 de-escalate, 0871 declare truce, ceasefire; 105, 107, 108; 125-127; 134-135; 164-165.

classes.name: Sanctions and other pressure
classes.source: Not from COW. CAMEO event codes 163, 1312, 085, 139
classes.codes: CAMEO 163 impose embargo, boycott, or sanctions; 1312 threaten to boycott, embargo, or sanction; 085 ease economic sanctions, boycott, embargo (and 0254, 0354, 1054, 1244); 139 give ultimatum.

classes.name: Internal power
classes.codes: CAMEO 14 protest (141 demonstrate or rally, 142 hunger strike, 143 strike or boycott, 144 obstruct passage, 145 protest violently, riot); change in leadership (0241, 0341, 1041, 0831, 1231); change in institutions, regime (0244, 0344, 1044, 0834, 1234); political reform (024, 034, 104); 1721 restrictions on political freedoms, 1722 ban political parties, 1723 curfew, 1724 state of emergency or martial law; 175 violent repression; 133, 082 political dissent.

classes.name: Holy places and religion
classes.source: Not from COW as events: COW's World Religion Data counts adherents and records no events. Its religions and families give the words, with the author's holy-place entries.
classes.codes: World Religion Data v1.1: Christianity (Protestant, Roman Catholic, Eastern Orthodox, Anglican), Judaism (Orthodox, Conservative, Reform), Islam (Sunni, Shi'a, Ibadhi, Nation of Islam, Alawite, Ahmadiyya), Buddhism (Mahayana, Theravada), Zoroastrian, Hindu, Sikh, Shinto, Baha'i, Taoism, Jain, Confucianism, Syncretic, Animist. The author's entries 0000014, 0000016, 0000017, 0000019, 0000025 (East Jerusalem), 0000072.

classes.name: Economic statecraft
classes.source: Not from COW, except its trade flows: COW Trade v4.0 (1870-2014); CAMEO economic codes
classes.codes: COW Trade v4.0: national and bilateral trade flows. CAMEO 061 cooperate economically (0211, 0311, 1011, 1211); 071 provide economic aid (0231, 0331, 1031, 1221); 1621 reduce or stop economic assistance; 1311 threaten to reduce or stop aid.
